verdict.rationale: Wise Business is a business payments and account product, so AI-driven GL coding is a fair accounting-integrations question. The evidence pack shows no AI categorization, no GL code assignment, and no multi-entity close tooling. Statement exports in accounting formats (CAMT.053, MT940, QIF) are adjacent data-export features, not automated GL coding.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI automatically assign GL codes to transactions across entities to accelerate close
